character_anchors.prompt_summary: A 20s Hispanic female outdoor enthusiast with athletic build, warm brown eyes, and dark braided hair. She wears a technical olive green outdoor jacket over high-performance hiking apparel. Rendered in clean cinematic 3D animation style with expressive feature modeling and realistic clothing materials.

location_anchors.prompt_summary: A high-altitude alpine hiking trail surrounded by dense pine tree valleys, rugged granite ridges, and open summit overlooks. The atmosphere features crisp morning golden sunlight, soft rising valley mist, and clear blue skies.

prop_anchors.prompt_summary: The NORTHSPUR brand mark consisting of dark blue sans-serif lettering centered beneath a minimal geometric mountain peak icon, presented cleanly on a flat solid white background.
